snippet.title: Dino-Ducks Mayhem  Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Dino-Ducks Mayhem is a twin-stick shooter with a bullet heaven vibe  game, wrapped around a duck-builder system,  set in a duck-tastic world and all about surviving as long as you can while everything explodes around you.
Come and take a look on steam! Our new demo is out! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3701920/DinoDucks_Mayhem_Demo/
